title: Outdated
subtitle: 「過時／老式／已淘汰／不再現行」，究竟是哪一種 outdated？
description: 「過時／老式／已淘汰／不再現行」，究竟是哪一種 outdated？

words.meaning: 老式的；過時而不合現代潮流的
words.note: 使用者提供的核心近義詞。通常形容款式、觀念、習慣或做法顯得屬於較早年代，不合現代風格；不一定完全不能用。
words.example: The décor looks old-fashioned compared with newer hotels.

exercises.original: The design looks outdated because its colours and layout belong to a much earlier style.
exercises.zh: 這個設計看起來過時，因為顏色和版面都屬於較早年代的風格。
exercises.upgrade: old-fashioned · 老式的；過時而不合現代潮流的

options.explanation: colours and layout + earlier style 是審美與風格上的過時，old-fashioned 比 obsolete 更自然。

words.meaning: 已淘汰的；已廢棄不用的；過時失效的
words.note: 使用者提供。比 outdated 更強，表示技術、設備、制度或方法已被新事物取代，基本不再使用或不再有實際價值。
words.example: The old software became obsolete after the new system was introduced.

exercises.original: The machine is outdated because replacement parts are no longer made and newer equipment has completely replaced it.
exercises.zh: 這部機器已被淘汰，因為零件已停產，而且新設備已完全取代它。
exercises.upgrade: obsolete · 已淘汰的；已廢棄不用的；過時失效的

options.explanation: no longer made + completely replaced 表示已退出實際使用，力度高於 merely outdated。
較正式，表示方法、制度或觀念已不適合現代情況。 本句有 replaced、no longer supported、parts no longer made 等『已退出使用』線索，要求比 outdated 更強。 因此在這一句裡不如 obsolete 精確。
正式表示已被一個較新版本／標準／規則明確取代。 本句有 replaced、no longer supported、parts no longer made 等『已退出使用』線索，要求比 outdated 更強。 因此在這一句裡不如 obsolete 精確。

falseSynonyms.zh: old-fashioned 常指風格、習慣或觀念屬於舊時代，但仍可能可用；outdated 更廣，可指資料、技術、規則。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The furniture looks old-fashioned. The statistics are outdated.

falseSynonyms.zh: obsolete 比 outdated 強，通常表示已被取代、基本不再使用。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The old system is obsolete. The website information is outdated.

falseSynonyms.zh: no longer current 專注資訊、規則、版本是否仍是最新／現行；outdated 還可指風格或設備。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The guidance is no longer current. The design looks outdated.

falseSynonyms.zh: antiquated 通常更強、更批判，表示極其陳舊、不合時宜。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The hospital uses antiquated equipment. The software interface looks outdated.

falseSynonyms.zh: superseded 必須有一個較新的版本／規則正式取代舊的；outdated 不一定已被正式替換。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The old standard was superseded by a new one. The old brochure is simply outdated.

falseSynonyms.zh: expired 表示有效期已過；只有票證、許可、證書等才適用。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The permit has expired. The information is outdated.

falseSynonyms.zh: vintage 常帶正面或收藏價值，不等於過時、不合用。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She bought a vintage watch. The database uses outdated software.

falseSynonyms.zh: outdated 是形容詞；update 可作名詞或動詞，表示更新／最新消息。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The document is outdated. Please update the document.
